correctness.rationale: The piecewise Euclidean source image potential on the bottom, four sides, and top is globally intrinsic 1-Lipschitz across seams, and each nearest-image unfolded straight segment gives an attaining surface path. The resulting area-preserving source development has radial boundary rho_h(φ)=min{1/(2sinφ),(h+1)/(cosφ+sinφ)} on 0≤φ≤π/4. Thus A_h(r)=4 ∫ min(r²,rho_h²)dφ, giving three displayed exact branches with thresholds 1/√2, sqrt(h²+h+1/2), h+1, C¹ but not C² and 4 ε² upper-end deficit. Differentiation and piecewise evaluation check normalizations and E[D²]=(4h³+9h²+8h+2)/(6(2h+1)). The ratios rho_h2/rho_h1 are nonincreasing in φ, so angular densities ordered by monotone likelihood ratio admit ordered angle quantile coupling; multiplying the ordered radial boundaries by common sqrt(U) proves strict CDF order on 0<r<h2+1. Separately computed polar quadratures and strict comparisons for positive sample heights reproduce all branches (finite checks only).
